notes: Rows 5 and 7 remain the two previously implemented profile quantity rules.
PR_11B adds exact rational rules for K14:K17, K22:K23, K29:K30, K43 and K45; X-family rows are marked not applicable for L3, not treated as general confirmed zero materials.
K43 and K45 have no catalog SKU in S1!F, but are source-described fastener lines in S1!G:H and were implemented as quantity formulas; their unit costs are already included in parent material costs.
S1!D22 is resolved by the workbook formula through Настройки!I27 and #1!G24:G26; the engine contract consumes the resolved choice and does not infer it from K29.
No saved Excel cache or Excel result is passed as an engine input. All source scenarios were recalculated with Excel 16 CalculateFullRebuild on temporary workbook copies.
Material prices, shared glue/activator pricing and S1!M53 are not asserted as supported.

PR_11C confirmed five additional selector-inactive positions K6, K8:K10, K13. The requested target 33 applicable / 9 inactive is therefore not source-supported for L3: 28 positions have active quantity rules and 14 are selector-inactive.
K12 mathematical rational is 1547/500 (3.094); Excel Value2 is 3.0940000000000003 in one case. Exact binary64 differs while the cell display 3.094 matches.
